resume_brief: TOP-200 HEART-AND-SOUL RESEARCH — WAVE 13 (owner directive 2026-10-06, top-200 expansion). For EACH of 10 games (Ghost of Tsushima, Horizon Forbidden West, God of War Ragnarök, Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales, Uncharted 4: A Thief's End, Bloodborne, Returnal, Gran Turismo 7, Death Stranding, The Last of Us Part II), find what the developers and people who work on it SAY keeps players coming back, playing, paying, and supporting it. METHOD: browser.search (e.g. "Sucker Punch interview Ghost of Tsushima design philosophy") + browser.open (fetch page text from links). NO live browser — search/fetch text only. OUTPUT: For each game write /home/hatch/workspace/agent-ops/top100-staging/wave-13/<slug>.md with EXACT structure: # <Game> — Heart and Soul; - Developer / studio:; - Genre / platforms:; - Why players come back (in the devs' view):; - Key quotes: (2-4; each: "quote" — Name, Role, Publication/Event, Year; append [unverified] if from a search snippet not a fetched page); - Why players love/support it:; - Monetization philosophy (devs' words, if any):; - Lesson for our games (1-2 lines, concrete):; - Sources: (URLs); - Coverage note: (if no on-record dev statements found, say so; label press analysis as ANALYSIS, never quotes). Slugs: ghost-of-tsushima, horizon-forbidden-west, god-of-war-ragnarok, spider-man-miles-morales, uncharted-4, bloodborne, returnal, gran-turismo-7, death-stranding, the-last-of-us-part-2. RULES: Sourced quotes ONLY — NEVER invent developer statements. Unverifiable quotes excluded. Snippet-sourced marked [unverified]. Do NOT commit to any git repo — staging dir ONLY. Write each file as finished (durable progress).
